outcomes: The merchant guard group arrives outside Stonebridge after traveling together for some time.
Stonebridge is described as a small, little-known town with a bridge over the river.

source_events.event_name: Learning about Stonebridge and the job board
outcomes: The town has The River's Edge Pub, run by Grishna, and a local job board.
Glowkindle has posted a help request for mercenaries to clean up rats.

source_events.event_name: Drinking at The River's Edge Pub
outcomes: The group drinks at The River's Edge Pub to wash away the road.
Grishna tells them Glowkindle has been through and gives directions to The Wizard's Tower Brewing Co.
Bonogo buys a firkin of ale for two gold and enjoys it.

source_events.event_name: Following the river trail to the big rock
outcomes: The party follows a clear trail along the river to an enormous boulder.
The boulder appears to be the foot of a once-enormous statue.

source_events.event_name: Arriving at The Wizard's Tower Brewing Company
outcomes: The group reaches The Wizard's Tower Brewing Company after a few more hours of walking.
The tap room is lit by magical crystals and is empty except for gnomes brewing inside.
Glowkindle explains that giant rats attacked his excavation crew after they broke through a wall expanding the fermentation cellar.
The party agrees to clear out the rats for 25 gold pieces each.

source_events.event_name: Fighting the giant rats in the fermentation cellar
outcomes: The team fights giant rats in Glowkindle's fermentation cellar.
Multiple party members go down during the fight, and many health potions are drunk.
A mysterious cat owl is tossed into the room to help.
The combat is described as a hard first battle for the team.
The party finds a beautifully tiled hallway.
They discover a trapped mosaic on the floor.
They also find a room full of broken alchemical tools.

source_events.event_name: Karsemine spots a magma-infused spider monstrosity
outcomes: Karsemine searches the room and looks up.
She makes eye contact with a flaming, magma-infused spider monstrosity, apparently another resident of the shatter mage's tower.
